name: generate_presentation
description:
Generate a branded presentation from a brief. Creates a fully styled, immersive web presentation with animations, charts, 3D elements, and scrollytelling components. Automatically deploys to a preview branch and creates a PR.

The framework ships exactly two templates:
- 'scroll' — immersive scroll narrative powered by the Phase 2 art-direction primitives (WebGL heroes, horizontal-pin case studies, scroll-linked 3D camera, path-draw spines, editorial grids, hero stats).
- 'slides' — traditional deck with keyboard nav, speaker notes, and PPTX export. Uses the Awwwards-tier slide layouts (hero-stat, editorial, full-bleed quote, chapter break, bento) with per-slide transitions and mood overrides.

Narrative posture (problem-solution, status-direction, etc.) is a separate field that tones the prompt; it does not change the template.

audience.description: Who will see this presentation (e.g. 'C-suite executives at ACME Corp', 'Engineering team', 'Conference attendees')

intent.description: What the audience should do after seeing this (e.g. 'Approve the AI transformation budget', 'Adopt the new testing framework')

mode.description: Presentation mode. 'scroll' for immersive narratives with parallax and scrollytelling. 'slides' for traditional decks with keyboard nav and PPTX export.

templateId.description: Optional. The framework ships one template per mode; defaults from `mode` when omitted.

posture.description: Optional narrative posture that tones the deck. 'validation-extension' for building on existing work, 'problem-solution' for proposing fixes, 'comparison-recommendation' for option tradeoffs, 'education-implication' for teaching first, 'status-direction' for status updates.

accentColor.description: Optional CSS color for key highlights (e.g. '#4EA8DE'). Defaults to your brand colors.

sourceMaterial.description: Raw text, markdown, or document content to use as primary source material. The AI will extract real data, quotes, and specifics from this. Never fabricates statistics.

additionalInstructions.description: Any additional instructions for the AI generator (e.g. 'Focus on cost savings', 'Include Arabic translations', 'Use 3D globe for the hero section')
